notes.title: Update for True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle Players
notes.content:
We’ve recently made an important update to the True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle. The issue affecting access to Part 1 has now been resolved for all future buyers.

Unfortunately, several users had already purchased the bundle before we noticed the mistake. If you're one of them and are having trouble accessing Part 1, please reach out to us at support@goblinz.com — we’ll be happy to help. As a token of apology for the inconvenience, we’ll provide a free key to affected players.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Update 2.012
notes.content:
Added languages: Chinese traditional, Chinese simplified, Turkish.
Localization have been improved.
Minigames fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Patch 2.0.11 is available !
notes.content:
- Partial graphic improvement
 - Bugfix and some improvement in Minigames
 - Analytics improvement

Please feel free to let us know about your ideas on the Steam Community thread, send us a DM on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/GoblinzGames or via email support@goblinz.com, any feedback is welcome!

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: Patch 2.0.2 is available!
notes.content:
The long-awaited update for Czechs and Romanians! New languages have appeared! We’ve improved the gameplay and fixed a number of errors. Our game has become even better) Play with us!

[list]
[*]More Languages! Romanian and Czech languages were added!
[*]UI update
[*]Widescreen panels support
[*]Game engine update
[*]Ability to replay Minigames and AHO and gain achievement in case you skip something in the game
[*]Ability to send User Report with screenshot to developers: menu Options, Support
[*]Guide was removed at the request of players: listen to the doll!
[*]Bugfix and minor improvement in Minigames
[*]Texts improvements
[*]Tutorials and analytics improvement
[/list]

notes.title: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part I has been updated!
notes.content:
The new version contains several bugs fixes found thanks to player feedback.
Thank you for your support and patience!

[list]
[*]improved performance
[*]fixed Hint/Skip at Act 1 Clocks and Act 3 Altar
[*]collecting figurine panel now with description text
[*]facts and clues in diary are now in order of collecting
[*]added new hints in logic puzzle scenes
[*]minor bug fixes and changes
[/list]

notes.title: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 1 Update + Part 2 free demo
notes.content:
The game has just been updated and you can now access the True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 2 playable demo from the Main Menu!


The game has also been updated to correct the following issues:
- Can't get the second stage of "What really happened" achievement collecting all the facts in the Act 1.
- Incorrect "Boss" achievement counter.
- Unable to skip Posing Game puzzle.
- Texts and localization.
- Controller UI bugs.
- Optimization.
- Other minor bugs.

Thank you for bringing those issues to our attention! ːThe_heartː
